newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria June producer prices rise 1.8 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria June producer prices rise 1.8 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Bulgaria's June producer price inflation was 1.8 percent, National Statistics Institute (NSI) preliminary figures showed.
BULGARIAN PRODUCER PRICES JUNE MAY JUNE'96

The NSI said in a statement it was amending its calculation method to reflect actual changes in the prices of separate products more adequately and to bring the method in line with European statistical standards.
So far, the NSI has calculated producer price inflation on the basis of average prices of more than 1,000 groups of industrial goods instead of using shifts in the prices of specific products.

Under this method, changes in the structure of those groups sometimes weighed more heavily on calculations than actual price shifts and the new method, expected to be introduced in September, would be more precise, the NSI said. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-91188
